newsitem.title: UK: Julius Baer names private banker to head London.
newsitem.headline: Julius Baer names private banker to head London.

text.p: Swiss private bank Julius Baer said it has appointed its London head of private banking, Frank Canosa, to run its London operations following the resignation of Philip Amphlett.
Canosa will continue to run private banking activities and will have Henry Wilkes, who will also run securities and foreign exchange, as his deputy.

"Private banking is the core business of the Julius Baer Group and Frank Canosa's appointment reflects the philosophy and orientation of our London branch," said Julius Baer chairman, Rudolf E. Baer in a statement.
